author: Parsifal-2045
body: #### PR description: This PR introduces a config run before the benchmarks in `runHLTTiming` start to try and reduce the occurrence of spikes at the beginning of a job, such as [this one](https://cmssdt.cern.ch/SDT/jenkins-artifacts/pull-request-integration/PR-890a4b/56078/hlt-p2-timing/gpu_hlt_memory_comparison.png) (image for posterity) It also reverts to using `cms-patatrack/patatrack-scripts` since https://github.com/cms-patatrack/patatrack-scripts/pull/61 got merged. #### PR validation: Purely technical change, to be tested by the bot
title: Introduce wakeup run in `runHLTTiming` to try and stabilise initial GPU memory spikes
